text:
I didn't wait. I grabbed the iron shutter and pulled it all the way down.

The lens went black. The whole lake went black. The eight little boat lamps went out one after another, like someone was walking past them and blowing them out. Then the screen faded, and a text box came up.

Light out. Thank you, keeper.

The game saved. The memory card screen showed one file with the lighthouse icon. Under it, where the play time should be, it said: nine keepers.

I turned the console off and sat there in the dark.
